title: Council of Ephesus, Nestorius's second letter to Cyril, from James Chrystal, Authoritative Christianity: The Third World Council, vol. 1 (1895), pp. 155–166

unit_bounds.first: ^\W{0,3}T[oy] the most religious and most dear-to-God

baseline.start: ^To the most religious and beloved of God, fellow minister Nestorius

check_note: Left out on purpose: Chrystal's bracketed summaries ([Section I.] and the rest), his notes and note numbers such as (290). Set differently from the print, with no word changed: his double quotation marks, printed as two single marks, are set as double; the words he set in small capitals for emphasis are in the letter's ordinary case; the quotation marks he puts round the letter's heading and close are gone. His words in square brackets inside a sentence, such as [at Nicaea], are his translation and stay.
